description: This line plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" as a function of input size, ranging from 128 to 1024 on a linear x-axis, with the y-axis scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.5. The plot displays four distinct lines, each representing a different model or model configuration evaluated on a specific benchmark. The blue line with circular markers represents "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," starting at approximately 0.20 at x=128 and rising to about 0.36 at x=1024. The orange line with square markers, labeled "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," begins at roughly 0.15 at x=128 and increases to approximately 0.42 at x=1024. The green line with triangular markers, labeled "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench," starts at approximately 0.07 at x=128 and rises to about 0.38 at x=1024. The red line with diamond markers, labeled "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," begins at approximately 0.24 at x=128, increases to about 0.42 at x=512, and continues to rise to approximately 0.52 at x=1024. All lines show an increasing trend across the x-axis, with the red line exhibiting the steepest slope and highest final value.
